result.topic_en: Euler derives a differential equation for the angle φ of an elastic curve, finds that the substitution dφ = u ds leads to an awkward integral, and then in §XXIX takes the simpler case p = q = 0, obtaining T = C cos(φ+D) and V = C sin(φ+D).
result.transcription:
CORP. SIVE FLEXIBIL. SEV ELASTIC. 401
Ex tertia statim colligimus sumto elemento $ds$ constante, $V = \frac{A dd\Phi}{ds^2}$, qui valor in I$^{ma}$ et II$^{da}$ substitutus praebet:
$dT + \frac{A d\Phi dd\Phi}{ds^2} = 0; \quad T = \frac{A d^3\Phi}{d\Phi . ds^2},$
prioris integrale manifesto est $T = B - \frac{A d\Phi^2}{2 ds^2}$, sicque eliminando T assequimur $\frac{2A d^3\Phi}{d\Phi} + A d\Phi^2 = 2B ds^2$, quae per $\frac{4 d\Phi dd\Phi}{A}$ multiplicata praebet: $8 dd\Phi d^3\Phi + 4 d\Phi^3 . dd\Phi = \frac{8B}{A} . ds^2 . d\Phi dd\Phi$, cuius integrale est $4 dd\Phi^2 + d\Phi^4 = \frac{4B}{A} . ds^2 . d\Phi^2 + C ds^4$ vnde elicitur
$dd\Phi = \surd\left(\frac{C}{4} ds^4 + \frac{B}{A} ds^2 d\Phi^2 - \frac{1}{4} d\Phi^4\right).$
Statuatur nunc $d\Phi = u ds$, vt obtineamus hanc aequationem:
$du = ds \surd\left(\frac{C}{4} + \frac{B}{A} . uu - \frac{1}{4} u^4\right)$ siue $ds = \frac{du}{\surd\left(C + \frac{4B}{A} uu - u^4\right)}.$
Verum hoc modo calculus fit nimis molestus, vnde ab initio eum multo commodius instituamus.

XXIX. Quoniam $p = 0$ et $q = 0$, ambae aequationes I. et II. quae sunt $dT + V d\Phi = 0$; $dV - T d\Phi = 0$, tres tantum continent variabiles T, V et $d\Phi$ ex quibus eliminando $d\Phi$ elicimus $T dT + V dV = 0$ vnde fit $TT + VV = CC$ et $T = \surd(CC - VV)$, qui in secunda substitutus praebet $dV = d\Phi \surd(CC - VV)$, siue $d\Phi = \frac{dV}{\surd(CC - VV)}$, vnde denuo integrando, Ang. cui. sin. $\frac{V}{C} = \Phi + D$ hincque $V = C \sin.(\Phi + D)$ et $T = C \cos.(\Phi + D)$. Quod hic ad angulum $\Phi$ attinet cuius differentiale tantum $d\Phi$ in nostras formulas principales ingreditur eius determinatio pen-
Tom. XV. Nou. Comm. Eee det

items.quote: Verum hoc modo calculus fit nimis molestus, vnde ab initio eum multo commodius instituamus.
items.english: But in this way the calculation becomes too troublesome, so let us set it up from the beginning in a much more convenient way.
